traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Acoraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers in spikes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule or berry; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 6; carpels (2-) 3 (-4). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 211, family Acoraceae: phyllotaxis pattern distichous; read as "distichous".

traits.leaf_form.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 211, family Acoraceae: leaf form blade (ensiform, unifacial, sword-like); read as "blade".

traits.stipules.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 211, family Acoraceae: stipules false; read as false.

traits.bract_form.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 211, family Acoraceae: bract form spathe (long, linear, leaf-like, continuing the peduncle); read as "spathe".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 211, family Acoraceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 211, family Acoraceae: rhizome habit short_creeping (rhizomatous stems), usually; read as {"short_creeping": "usually"}.

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Acoraceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
